nom: Filorga Time-Filler 5-XP Wrinkle Correction Moisturizing, Enhanced Anti Aging Formula to Reduce and Repair Face, Eye, and Neck Wrinkles and Fine Lines

avis.texte: This is the second jar of cream I've used, it has been a big change in my skin (especially on my pores). The texture is not greasy and absorbs very easily into your skin, leaving you feeling hydrated for longer, with very little amount you can cover the skin of your face and neck. Obviously not everything is a matter of the cream, but works well with the whole care of your skincare (drinking enough water, avoiding mistreating the skin on a daily basis, applying sunscreen and, above all, consistency, which is the key to getting great results).
I honestly see no changes or difference between this brand and cheaper ones. I hoped I would see significant changes in a week or so. But nothing
I have to say this stuff works. It has little to no smell. Love the way it feels and yes it does what it says
Mi 3er frasco me ha ayudado mucho a mi cara, recomendado por dermatologa

avis.titre: It is an excellent product for those with sensitivity of the skin.
avis.texte: I have been using the eye cream which I love, I just purchased this one not long ago. So far I like it
Funciona,es una crema buenísima, estoy encantada tengo 51 años y me veo la piel facial cada día mejor

avis.titre: Fantastic cream! No issues on my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and I have tried so many kinds of creams, including the ones the dermatologist have recommended me. This one is great, I did not have any reaction after use it, unlike the “unify” that made me feel itchy and hurt so I had to wash my face immediately. This cream makes my face very hydrated and fresh, it’s 10/10. Also, I bought it with discount here, really highly recommend! Especially for the dry and cold weather in Canada :)
I have been using this for 2 years now and I am happy with it. my skin is mixed but more dry, I like how it moisturize my skin and close the visible pores

This moisturizer feels so luxurious! It’s lightweight but intensely hydrating. It leaves my skin feeling so soft, nourished and hydrated. I can absolutely see how with continued use it will help with signs of anti aging and/or wrinkles. This moisturizer has a handful of good ingredients that I recognize (which is mainly peptides, ascorbic acid, squalane, sodium hyaluronate, niacinamide, niacin, and a handful of other deeply moisturizing/hydrating ingredients) Some of the ingredients I don’t recognize but, with that being said, I’ve been using this cream daily some days twice a day for 2 weeks now and i have not experienced any issues or complications from using this moisturizer. I have found my skin to feel more soft, hydrated and nourished by using this moisturizer daily. My skin looks more youthful and supple while feeling incredibly soft and hydrated. After application the moisturized fully absorbs maybe 10/15 minutes after applying. The moisturizer does have a sweet subtle scent that I have been enjoying during application. This is my first experience with the French brand Filorga and I have been thoroughly enjoying it! I would whole heartedly recommend this moisturizer to anyone as every could benefit from using this product daily. I’m excited to see what this moisturizer will do for my skin in terms of wrinkles and anti aging with continued use. I couldn’t be happier with this moisturizer. **photo for full ingredient list

Luxurious, rich and super hydrating. It has a thicker consistency and is lightweight which is surprising. Non greasy and quickly absorbed. It has a light and very fresh scent that I can’t quite place but absolutely love. Very crisp and soothing. I have very sensitive, mature skin and deeper wrinkles and definitely feel a deeper hydration. I tested without using a serum first so I’m genuinely surprised how well it works without having that annoying, “tight” feeling that some firming cremes have. Absolutely love this one. If anything, the smell alone makes me want to put on another layer!

I'm in love with this facial cream! It is lightweight and smooth, feels luxurious and my skin soaks it in like a sponge. It has softened my skin and smoothed it. It gives me a healthy, youthful glow. The lines, weathering, and ravages of time on my face sort of melt away. It has a premium price, yet is economical in a sense that a little goes a long way. The scent is quite pleasant too. If you are shopping in this price class this is an exceptional facial cream. Highly recommended!

I’ve never had to use the word, “ Luxurious”, to describe a product, but Woah, this face cream is out of this world Luxurious! I just used it for the 1st time and omg my face feels like mulberry silk! Pure luxury. It’s so creamy yet light and smells like a high end face cream. I’m in love with this wonderful product. I Highly Recommend.

Should be advertised as moisturizing lotion and not as a wrinkle removing face cream. Does not tighten skin at all. Was put on right side of forehead and just stayed moist on the skin with no tightening happening. See picture below

This cream feels very nice when applied. It also has a very light scent a bit perfumy but light enough that it won't bug me. It feels very nice when it gets absorbed. Also makes your skin feel more elasticity.... that is if you skin is not resembling shriveled old prune like mine does sometimes.... ok maybe not that bad. But this makes it all better.

Nice consistency. It spreads evenly and smooth and absorbs well. No sticky residue or tack left behind. Make up applies well over top of it. Has a sweet, almost fruity scent. Skin feels smooth and happy.
